status: Prospective claim-specific draft; numerical task tolerances and meaningful-gain budget unset, not an achieved admission
userPrinciple: Reasonable discrepancy is acceptable; no requirement for pointwise identical waveforms
researchTarget: Synchronization gain with explicitly reported tracking/peak/compute costs. Not all-metric superiority.

threeDifferentClaims.illustrativeMechanism: A declared-assumption simulation can illustrate behavior, but cannot be labeled identified/predictively validated hardware or substitute for physical evidence.
threeDifferentClaims.absolutePrediction: Freeze model and initial-state estimator; test independent ordinary and candidate whole trajectories with original windows and phase metrics. Absolute tolerances need task or measurement rationale, not current-fit errors.
threeDifferentClaims.comparisonPrediction: Evaluate predicted versus observed gain/cost directly. Large correlated absolute errors may cancel; this is a hypothesis to validate in method differences, not an automatic pass. A faithful forced-response replay is still not a counterfactual closed-loop efficacy test.

definitions.differencePredictionError: Predicted method difference minus independently observed method difference
definitions.sameWindow: Original native40ms complete phase2..5, no choosing only favorable phases after results

noTaskToleranceFallback: Report tracking-sync tradeoff without claiming task-acceptable cost. Do not invent positioning requirements.
prospectiveStoppingRules: No continuing fit merely to overlay every point. Stop fitting at fixed model-selection budget or when preregistered validation requirements are met.
If critical predicted sync magnitude/direction does not reproduce observation, keep the model as an exploratory failure; do not relax thresholds after viewing it.
For claimed quantitative gains, specify difference-error budgets before new validation. Include run-to-run variability; one pair checks feasibility but not repeatability.
A sufficient empirical sign-resolution condition is predicted sync gain larger than its validated difference-error bound plus declared variability allowance. A training residual is not such a bound.
If revising after validation failure, that dataset becomes exploration and the next validation must remain independent. Never select only the successful run.
All earlier errors and failed branches remain preserved. No automatic new hardware batch.
selfDerivedRMSTriangleCheck: For the same finite window, |RMS(pred)-RMS(actual)| <= RMS(pred-actual). For two methods, difference-metric error <= epsilonOrdinary+epsilonCandidate. These are empirical vector inequalities, not universal prediction guarantees. Direct difference validation can reveal cancellation not captured by the summed bound.
former2umProposal: Retained as earlier unapproved gain-resolution discussion. Not a universal mandatory model threshold and not adopted here.
